title: Fraction coefficients of a pulled tautological quotient
statement: Let $h:T\to S$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme], $\mathcal E$ a quasi-coherent module [pqf-def-coherent], and $D$ any normalized tautological quotient on $P=\operatorname{Proj}_S\operatorname{Sym}(\mathcal E)$ [def-per-projective-bundle-quotient-data]. Let $a:T\to P$ satisfy $a;p=h$, and let $\psi$ be any graded extension [lem-trf-line-quotient-homogeneous-fraction-map] of its normalized pulled quotient $q_a$ [def-trf-line-quotient-chart-inverse-data]. Then $\psi$ satisfies $\mathrm{HasQuotientFractionCharts}$ at $a$. Moreover $\mathrm{RecoveredFractionCoefficients}$ holds [def-trf-line-quotient-chart-inverse-data]: on each affine $W$ factoring through the chart $D_+(\iota(m))$, the coefficient of every degree-$d$ element $c$ in the pulled $\iota(m)$ frame equals the pullback of $c/\iota(m)^d$, including degree zero.

source.place: Tags 01OA (section-projective-bundle) and 01O4 (lemma-apply-relative); inverse quotient constructions and their arbitrary-pullback compatibility, with the explicit degree-one chart calculations.

proof.text: On an affine W factoring through a standard generator chart for a, apply [lem-trf-line-quotient-pulled-chart-normalization]. This gives a free pulled generator frame, the scalar ring map of k, and the degree-one images of the pulled quotient. The coefficient ring homomorphism from [lem-trf-graded-line-homogeneous-fraction-atlas], applied to the existing quotientFramePower and quotientCoefficient equations of [lem-trf-line-quotient-homogeneous-fraction-map], sends scalars and generators to these values. Induct on membership in the dth power of the symmetric generator submodule [def-trf-canonical-symmetric-graded-algebra]: the base case is a scalar, the additive case uses equal-denominator addition, and the product case multiplies x/e^i by v/e. This proves every coefficient equals k^*(c/e^d), including degree zero. In particular the denominator generator has coefficient one.

For any fraction-chart morphism F supplied by [lem-trf-line-quotient-homogeneous-fraction-map], its chart ring map on this W sends c/e^d to the localization of the recovered coefficient, since the denominator coefficient is one. Every degree-zero homogeneous fraction has this form. Thus this map equals the scalar extension of k ring map. Contravariant functoriality and the affine-spectrum adjunction [def-weil-affine-spectrum] identify the corresponding scheme maps, proving F and a agree on the generator fraction source above W.

The degree-one generators cover every affine symmetric Proj, by [prop-nagata-proj-standard-open] and the symmetric-algebra generation property [def-trf-canonical-symmetric-graded-algebra]. The relative-Proj affine embeddings [def-nagata-relative-proj] and open-immersion lifting therefore give a chart factorization k on an affine neighbourhood W of every source point. Its generator fraction source has opensRange W because its coefficient is one. Apply [lem-weil-pbc-scheme-morphism-gluing] to the local equalities to conclude F=a.

The pulled line is invertible by [lem-weil-pbc-invertible-pullback-tensor]. The section-normalized tensor pullback is a left adjoint and preserves epimorphisms, so pulledQuotient is epi. Obtain an extension and its chart morphism F from [lem-trf-line-quotient-homogeneous-fraction-map]; uniqueness of the extension identifies it with the given psi. Substitute F=a into its full fraction-chart predicate. Together with the all-degree identity proved in Step 1, this gives both required conclusions without changing their statements.

proof_origin.place: Tags 01OA and 01O4: explicit all-degree induction, normalized fraction chart comparison and local scheme equality; only the local degree-one tautological normalization is split off.
